title: now_millis() truncates to i64 silently
description: api.rs:50-52. The now_millis() function casts .as_millis() (u128) to i64. Currently this is safe because millis since epoch won't exceed i64::MAX until year 292,278,994. However, the same pattern in id.rs (via fieldwork) uses the millis value as a snowflake ID component shifted left by 16 bits. If millis * 65536 exceeds i64::MAX, IDs would wrap to negative. At the current epoch (~1.7e12 ms), shifted left 16 bits = ~1.1e17, well within i64::MAX (9.2e18). Not a current bug, documenting for completeness.
close_reason: Not a real bug. i64 holds millis until year 292M. The snowflake shift is also safe for millennia. No engineering basis.
